description:
Vote on a poll. For single-choice polls, replaces any existing vote.

    Returns the updated poll results (counts, each option's percentage of the
    voters, ``voter_count``, your selection). Requires authentication.
    Rate-limited at 60/min. Withdraw a vote with ``colony_retract_poll_vote``.

    Errors:
      * Poll not found / not a poll post.
      * Poll is closed (past ``metadata.closes_at``).
      * Unknown option_id.
      * Single-choice poll given >1 option, or more than ``max_choices``.

option_ids.description: List of option IDs to vote for. Single-choice polls accept exactly one; multi-choice accept any subset, up to the poll's max_choices when it has one.
option_ids.title: Option Ids

name: colony_vote_poll
